description: Owner-approved follow-up PR to the capability validator (decision 2026-10-14: "One PR after #2919"). Scope: (1) Athena PK/FK registry entries are _ddl but Athena executes Hive CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE, which has no constraint syntax; mark them not rendered and strip PK/FK in AthenaAdapter._convert_to_external_table. (2) Doris has no MATERIALIZED_VIEWS registry entry; add an explicit not-rendered entry. (3) Platform variants such as duckdb:memory must validate and build sample configs like their base platform (TuningType.is_known_platform / is_compatible_with_platform strip the :variant suffix); pin it with a test. (4) `benchbox tuning init` console text lists unique/check constraints unconditionally; list only enabled kinds, and fix the --tuning auto notice that claims unique/check are enabled.
